china-1922:p0515_1.rationale: Mail matter posted by district and by class of article (letters, postcards, newspapers, parcels etc.), which is postal operations. The Total row is unreadable but the structure establishes the quantities.

china-1922:p0516_1.rationale: Articles posted for local delivery by district, comparing 1920 with 1919; postal traffic statistics.

china-1922:p0517_1.rationale: Articles collected from letter boxes and pillar boxes by district, with 1919 comparison; postal traffic.

china-1922:p0518_1.rationale: Number and insured value of insured letters posted by district, 1917-1920; a postal service statistic. Insurance here is a postal service, not an insurance business.

china-1922:p0519_1.rationale: Mail matter (packages, weight, letters contained) posted by Minchü (private letter agencies) by district for 1917-1920; mail handling.
review_questions: Minchü (private letter hongs) are not covered by a dedicated tag; postal-services is the closest fit.

china-1922:p0520_1.rationale: Ordinary, insured and C.O.D. parcels posted by district, with number, value and weight; postal parcel traffic.

china-1922:p0521_1.rationale: Postal money orders issued and cashed by district, number and value, 1919-1920; postal money transfers.

china-1922:p0522_1.rationale: Post Office Savings Bank deposits, withdrawals, amounts due to depositors and investments of the funds; postal savings is a financial service run through the postal channel.

china-1922:p0523_1.rationale: A list of three cable companies operating in China, textual with no quantities; telegraph (cable) services.
review_questions: Foreign cable companies in China might relate to foreign privilege, but no such evidence in the table.

china-1922:p0523_2.rationale: Chinese Government Telegraphs statistics: land-lines, wires, cables, instruments, offices, telegrams and construction dates and lengths of principal lines.
